q: 1. 'Every woman shall have right relating to safe motherhood and reproductive health', which article deals with this statement?
explain: This is part of the 'Rights of Women' provisioned in Article 38.

q: 2. What would be the life expectancy at birth of people of Nepal at the end of the 16th plan?
explain: Improved healthcare outcomes under the 16th Plan are expected to raise the average life expectancy to 73 years.

q: 3. The headquarters of Food and Agriculture Organization is in -----------
explain: The FAO is headquartered in Rome, Italy.
